--src: Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
theorem mem_pure (x y : α) : x ∈ (pure y : List α) ↔ x = y := by simp

--src: Mathlib.Data.Semiquot
theorem isPure_iff {s : Semiquot α} : IsPure s ↔ ∃ a, s = pure a :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨_, eq_pure h⟩, fun ⟨_, e⟩ => e.symm ▸ pure_isPure _⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Functor
@[simp]
theorem pure_def {α} : (pure : α → Multiset α) = singleton :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Defs
instance : LawfulFunctor Set where
  id_map _ := funext fun _ ↦ propext ⟨fun ⟨_, sb, rfl⟩ ↦ sb, fun sb ↦ ⟨_, sb, rfl⟩⟩
  comp_map g h _ := funext <| fun c ↦ propext
    ⟨fun ⟨a, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨g a, ⟨⟨a, ⟨h₁, rfl⟩⟩, h₂⟩⟩,
     fun ⟨_, ⟨⟨a, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩, h₃⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨a, ⟨h₁, show h (g a) = c from h₂ ▸ h₃⟩⟩⟩
  map_const := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.Basic
theorem pure_sets (a : α) : (pure a : Filter α).sets = { s | a ∈ s } :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Topology.Order
@[simp]
theorem nhds_discrete (α : Type*) [TopologicalSpace α] [DiscreteTopology α] : @nhds α _ = pure :=
  le_antisymm (fun _ s hs => (isOpen_discrete s).mem_nhds hs) pure_le_nhds

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.Ultrafilter
theorem eq_pure_of_finite [Finite α] (f : Ultrafilter α) : ∃ a, f = pure a :=
  (eq_pure_of_finite_mem finite_univ univ_mem).imp fun _ ⟨_, ha⟩ => ha

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.Basic
theorem pure_le_principal {s : Set α} (a : α) : pure a ≤ �� s ↔ a ∈ s := by
  simp

--src: Mathlib.Data.Set.Functor
instance : LawfulMonad Set := LawfulMonad.mk'
  (id_map := image_id)
  (pure_bind := biUnion_singleton)
  (bind_assoc := fun _ _ _ => by simp only [bind_def, biUnion_iUnion])
  (bind_pure_comp := fun _ _ => (image_eq_iUnion _ _).symm)
  (bind_map := fun _ _ => seq_def.symm)

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.Defs
@[simp]
protected theorem mem_sets : s ∈ f.sets ↔ s ∈ f :=
  Iff.rfl

  simp_rw [univLE_iff_cardinal_le]; apply le_total

    ¬Surjective f := fun h => not_surjective_of_ordinal _ (h.comp (equivShrink _).symm.surjective)

protected theorem zero_le (o : Ordinal) : 0 ≤ o :=
  inductionOn o fun _ r _ => (InitialSeg.ofIsEmpty _ r).ordinal_type_le

    exact h.not_lt (add_lt_add_left h' a)⟩

instance : WellFoundedLT NatOrdinal :=
  Ordinal.wellFoundedLT
